'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Prime Minister of Haiti|Haitian Prime Minister]] [[Ariel Henry]] survives an assassination attempt when shooters opened fire at a ceremony celebrating the country's independence anniversary in a church in the city of [[Gonaïves]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-59863052 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021–2022 Boulder County fires]]
**At least three people are confirmed missing, and at least 988 homes are confirmed destroyed, after a wildfire struck [[Boulder County, Colorado]], [[United States]], since December 30. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/01/01/us/colorado-wildfires-saturday/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Vaishno Devi Temple stampede]]
**Twelve people are killed and 13 others injured during a [[Stampede#Human stampedes|stampede]] at the [[Vaishno Devi Temple]] in [[India]]n-administered [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Kashmir]], triggered by many people who were at the temple to celebrate the [[New Year]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/1/12-dead-in-stampede-at-religious-shrine-in-india (Al Jazeera)] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/vaishno-devi-stampede-live-updates-january-1/liveblog/88627999.cms (''The Times of India'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]]
*****[[England]] reports a record 162,572 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/covid-cases-england-today-latest-b1985376.html (''The Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] surpasses 10 million cases of COVID-19, becoming the sixth country to reach the milestone. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/france-reports-over-200000-new-daily-covid-cases-fourth-day-running-2022-01-01/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****The [[Republic of Ireland]] reports a record 23,281 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.independent.ie/news/record-23281-new-cases-of-covid-19-reported-as-officials-warn-true-number-of-cases-likely-to-be-higher-41200823.html (''Irish Independent'')]
***[[Europe]] surpasses 100 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.voanews.com/a/omicron-coronavirus-variant-sweeps-across-the-globe/6377972.html (Voice of America)] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bahrain]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****[[Bahrain]] authorizes the emergency use of [[Pfizer]]'s anti-viral [[oral drug]] [[Paxlovid]] for adults over the age of 18 years. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1996396/middle-east (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]], [[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****The [[United Arab Emirates]] announces that unvaccinated citizens will be banned from travel and that [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Arab Emirates|vaccinated]] citizens will need to receive a [[booster dose]] of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] beginning on January 10. [https://gulfnews.com/uae/covid-19-uae-announces-travel-ban-on-unvaccinated-citizens-from-jan-10-1.1641042016457 (''Gulf News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] imposes a mandatory [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 vaccination certificate]] for people over the age of 13 years to participate in many types of activities, both indoors and outdoors. [https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/argentina/covid-cases-climb-to-record-high-in-argentina-surpassing-50000-in-24-hours.phtml (''Buenos Aires Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Australia]] reports a record for the twelfth consecutive day of 35,326 new cases of [[COVID-19]]. [[New South Wales]], [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] and other states report record numbers of new cases. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2022/jan/01/australia-news-live-nyd-covid-omicron-nsw-victoria-queensland-scott-morrison-weather (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Birth control in France]]
**France begins to introduce free [[birth control]] to women aged 18 to 25 years to reduce the number of [[unwanted pregnancies]]. Up to three million women will receive enhanced access to contraceptive [[Oral contraceptive pill|pills]], [[intrauterine device]]s, [[contraceptive patch|patches]] and [[Combined injectable birth control|injectables]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/france-to-make-birth-control-free-for-women-aged-18-25/a-60304913 (DW)]
*France officially bans the use of plastic packaging for large vegetables and fruits, such as cucumbers, carrots, and bananas. [[Spain]] plans to introduce a similar law in 2023. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/dec/31/thats-a-wrap-french-plastic-packaging-ban-for-fruit-and-veg-begins (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Israel]] reports the world's first case of "florona," which is believed to be a double infection of COVID-19 and [[influenza]], in an unvaccinated pregnant woman who was admitted to the [[Rabin Medical Center]] to give birth. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/what-is-florona-flu-plus-corona-first-detected-in-israel-all-you-need-to-know-101641027672824-amp.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Finland–Russia relations]], [[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Finland]] rejects [[Russia]]n demands that it never join the [[North Atlantic Treaty Organization]], with [[President of Finland|President]] [[Sauli Niinistö]] saying that it is his country's right to join the [[military alliance]] if it wants to. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2022/01/01/finland-reiterates-right-join-nato-despite-russian-pressure/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Austria]] legalizes [[assisted suicide]] for people over the age of 18 years who are [[terminally ill]] or who suffer from a permanent, debilitating condition. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59847371 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Protesters in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], hold a rally to mark the second anniversary of the assassination of [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] general [[Qasem Soleimani]]. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-iran-iraq-baghdad-qassim-soleimani-b9b28a97d363a041f11d024cee224865 (AP)]
